name: Accounts Payable - Payment Request Voucher
script:
# Prints the "Payment Request Voucher" for invoices picked in the Accounts Payable report.
# Called by the "Accounts Payable - Payment Request Voucher" Client Script.
# args: invoices = JSON list of {"doctype": "Purchase Invoice" | "Subcontract Invoice",
#       "invoice": <name>, "amount": <amount requested>}, paid_from, mode_of_payment. Nothing is saved.

rows = json.loads(frappe.form_dict.invoices or "[]")
if not rows:
    frappe.throw(_("Select at least one invoice"))

# get_list applies the user's permissions; both are shaped alike for the voucher
open_invoices = {}
for pi in frappe.get_list(
    "Purchase Invoice",
    filters={"name": ["in", [r.get("invoice") for r in rows]], "docstatus": 1},
    fields=["name", "supplier", "company", "bill_no", "due_date", "grand_total", "outstanding_amount"],
):
    open_invoices[("Purchase Invoice", pi.name)] = pi

for si in frappe.get_list(
    "Subcontract Invoice",
    filters={"name": ["in", [r.get("invoice") for r in rows]], "docstatus": 1},
    fields=["name", "supplier", "company", "supplier_invoice_no", "grand_total", "paid_amount"],
):
    si.bill_no = si.supplier_invoice_no
    si.outstanding_amount = frappe.utils.flt(
        frappe.utils.flt(si.grand_total, 2) - frappe.utils.flt(si.paid_amount, 2), 2
    )
    open_invoices[("Subcontract Invoice", si.name)] = si

voucher = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
first = None
for row in rows:
    doctype = row.get("doctype") or "Purchase Invoice"
    name = row.get("invoice")
    inv = open_invoices.get((doctype, name))
    if not inv or frappe.utils.flt(inv.outstanding_amount) <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_(doctype) + " " + frappe.bold(name) + " " + _("has no outstanding amount"))

    if first and inv.supplier != first.supplier:
        frappe.throw(_("All invoices in a Payment Request Voucher must be for the same supplier"))
    first = first or inv

    amount = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("amount"), 2)
    if amount <= 0 or amount > frappe.utils.flt(inv.outstanding_amount):
        frappe.throw(
            _("Payment Amount for") + " " + frappe.bold(name) + " "
            + _("must be more than 0 and not more than its outstanding") + " "
            + frappe.bold(frappe.utils.fmt_money(inv.outstanding_amount, 2))
        )

    voucher.append("references", {
        "reference_doctype": doctype,
        "reference_name": name,
        "bill_no": inv.bill_no,
        "due_date": inv.due_date,
        "total_amount": inv.grand_total,
        "outstanding_amount": inv.outstanding_amount,
        "allocated_amount": amount,
    })

voucher.name = first.name
voucher.payment_type = "Pay"
voucher.posting_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
voucher.company = first.company
voucher.party_type = "Supplier"
voucher.party = first.supplier
voucher.party_name = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier", first.supplier, "supplier_name") or first.supplier
voucher.mode_of_payment = frappe.form_dict.mode_of_payment
voucher.paid_from = frappe.form_dict.paid_from or frappe.db.get_value("Company", first.company, "default_bank_account")
voucher.paid_from_account_currency = frappe.db.get_value("Company", first.company, "default_currency")

frappe.response["filename"] = "Payment Request " + frappe.utils.nowdate() + ".pdf"
frappe.response["filecontent"] = frappe.get_print(
    "Payment Entry", voucher.name, "Payment Request Voucher", doc=voucher, as_pdf=True, no_letterhead=1
)
frappe.response["type"] = "pdf"
